EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/21. Land Min’s Ref No.: 4/3/10/2013/LRB/155.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the abandon paddy field described below and located between Horana - Colombo bus route and Ranketha Place at Paropakara Mawatha, Boralesgamuwa to create a water reserve, water tank, water ways and townscape development under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project. Description of the land to be acquired:

Twenty eight (28) allotments of land in total Extent of 2.7016 hectares depicted as Lot No. 09 to 15 and Lot No. 17 to 37 in the Preliminary Plan No. Co. 9585 dated 10.03.2016 prepared by the Survey General situated in the village called Boralesgamuwa East A in the Grama Niladhari division No. 533 of Boralesgamuwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District of Western Province and more fully described as follows. 01. Development Corporation, No. 03, Sri Jayawardenapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya on 28.06.2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in Duplicate) on or before the 21.06.2016, the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
